key.nusmp.spirit_space_link: Spirit of Space: link or unlink the spirit
key.nusmp.spirit_space_cycle: Spirit of Space: next ability (with Sneak: next waypoint slot)
key.nusmp.spirit_space_use: Spirit of Space: use the picked ability
nusmp.spirit_space.refused: The Spirit of Space does not answer you.
nusmp.spirit_space.full: The Spirit of Space cannot answer: too many spirits are out.
nusmp.spirit_space.linked: A tear in space opens beside you: the Spirit of Space answers.
nusmp.spirit_space.unlinked: The tear closes. The spirit returns to the space between.
nusmp.spirit_space.cooldown: The spirit is still gathering itself.
nusmp.spirit_space.slot: There is no such waypoint slot.
nusmp.spirit_space.ground: Stand on solid ground to mark a waypoint.
nusmp.spirit_space.empty: No waypoint is set in that slot.
nusmp.spirit_space.dimension: That waypoint lies in another dimension: the spirit cannot cross dimensions.
nusmp.spirit_space.far: That waypoint is beyond the reach of the portal.
nusmp.spirit_space.mana: Not enough mana to hold a portal open.
nusmp.spirit_space.unloaded: The far side is not there yet: nobody has been near it lately.
nusmp.spirit_space.nolanding: There is no safe ground at that waypoint.
subtitles.nusmp.spirit_space.wisp: The spirit swells into a dragon
subtitles.nusmp.spirit_space.voice_warbl: The Spirit of Space warbles anxiously
